# Public installer test packages

These are synthetic host-test fixtures, not installable applications or production
trust anchors. `test-*` uses the existing public deterministic test seeds from
`crates/app-package-core/src/lib.rs::tests::keys`; `alternate-*` uses public test
seeds [8;32]/[10;32]. Only public anchors and signed packages are stored here.

Versions 1 and 2 contain the existing `valid_user_elf` fixture and are signed by
both maintained Ed25519 and ML-DSA implementations already pinned in the project.
The package ID is `org.example.notes`. Both versions use ABI 1.0–1.9. Signatures and
ELF policy were verified during generation; the installer tests must verify them
again. No runtime or signing dependency is added to app-management.

Generation reused the unchanged private `TestKeys`, `valid_user_elf` and verifier
helpers from source `6f29b672` in an ignored copy under
`build/installer-fixture-generator/`. The sole added test writes both versions and
public anchors for the two key sets. Its isolated dependency graph was checked to
be a subset of the repository's Cargo.lock (including ctutils 0.4.7); no product
manifest or lockfile changed. Run the `export_installer_public_fixtures` test with
`BARYONOS_FIXTURE_OUTPUT` pointing here. `SHA256SUMS` binds the generated bytes.

The initial scratch lock required pruning; its first offline generation selected
ctutils 0.4.8. That diagnostic run is not the provenance accepted here. The scratch
lock was corrected to 0.4.7 and all fixtures regenerated with the existing locked
versions. Final raw command receipt remains in the lead's ignored Token Guard logs.
